professor.title_en: Associate Professor, Division of Computer Engineering, HUFS / Director, PMI Lab
bio_en: Prof. Jae Young Choi received the M.S. and Ph.D. degrees from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Daejeon, South Korea, in 2008 and 2011, respectively. In 2008, he was a visiting scholar at the University of Toronto and from 2011 to 2012, he was a Post-Doctoral Researcher with the University of Toronto. He was a Postdoc Fellow with the University of Pennsylvania (UPenn) from 2012 to 2013. He was a Senior Engineer with SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS from 2013 to 2014. He is currently an Associate Professor with Division of Computer Engineering, Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and Director of Pattern Recognition and Machine Intelligence (PMI) Lab.

His research interests include deep learning, ensemble machine learning, pattern recognition, and computer vision. Especially, he has developed several pioneering algorithms for automatic face recognition using facial color information. He is the author or co-author of over 100 refereed research publications in the aforementioned research areas. Prof. Choi was the recipient of the best paper award of Korea Multimedia Society in 2021. He was also the recipient of Samsung HumanTech Thesis Prize in 2010.
